data.name: Ismail
data.gender_notes: Ismail is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Yishmaʿel, 'God hears'. Its root is Hebrew y-sh-m-ʿ-ʾ-l. The prophet Ismāʿīl (Ishmael), son of Ibrāhīm. Ismail is a Arabic name meaning “God hears”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ismail expresses “God hears”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Yishmaʿel, 'God hears'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ismail total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
